name: basis-weighted-programs-v1
priors: Fixed bounded input program grammar, BOS1/separator18 syntax for generated quantities, injective ordinal raw-class coordinates and identity copy. No task identity, target generator, selected formula, unknown clean labels or heldout labels enter discovery or model execution.
selection: All declared candidates use every observed training position unless rejected by undefined output or an identity-copy contradiction. Prefer an exact observed affine fit; otherwise minimize complete weighted training CE at the declared observed-moment initializer. Deterministic bank-order ties. Retain one program. Selection is outside convex CE.
initialization: Observed-label coordinate means, a two-variable affine quantity moment estimate, and separate observed role means; copy coefficient one. No estimate becomes an extra exact anchor. The full joint starting tensor is projected, saved and replayed.
anchors: Exact fits retain all original anchors. Otherwise retain only observed structural-role groups whose training labels agree; every noisy observation remains in CE. Removing anchors removes their identification guarantee.
categorical_control: Same selected input program; frozen observed atom-to-mean-coordinate dictionary, class0 for absent entries, explicit identity copy. All original noisy labels still enter CE.
scoring: Every original split and mask; generative raw/exact scores use own-output rollout. Train-clean is diagnostic only. Training traces reference complete feature groups and retain every original row/position; heldout queries retain complete individual logits and independent complex-product checks. No novel-only score replaces the original metric.
